3008.211993 AGREEMENTREGARDINGDEVELOPMENTRIGHTS This Agreement Regarding Development Rights (the “Agreement") dated April2, 2009 between RED APPLE MYRTLE AVENUE DEVELOPMENT, LLC, a NewYork limited liability company with offices at 823EleventhAvenue,NewYork, New York 10019 ("Myrtle Avenue I") and RED APPLE MYRTLE AVENUE DEVELOPMENT II, LLC, a New York limited liability company with offices at 823 Eleventh Avenue, New York, New York 10019 (*Myrtle Avenue II"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Myrtle Avenue I is the owner of property known as Block 2061, Lot 1, Brooklyn, New York which property is more particularly described on Exhibit A annexed hereto and made a part hereof (the “Myrtle Avenue I Property"); WHEREAS, Myrtle Avenue I subdivided the Myrtle Avenue I Property and property known as Block 2061, Lot 101,Brooklyn, New York was created on the tax maps of the City of New York (the “Myrtle Avenue II Property"), which property is more particularly described on Exhibit B annexed hereto and made a part hereof (the Subdivision"); WHEREAS, the Myrtle Avenue II Property was conveyed by Myrtle September 17, 2008 in the Office of the Register of the City of New York, County of WHEREAS, Myrtle Avenue I and University Towers Apartment Corp. ("University") entered into a Zoning Lot Merger Purchase and Sale Agreement dated June 14, 2007, wherein University agreed to sell to Myrtle Avenue I certain development WHEREAS, Myrtle Avenue I and University entered into a Zoning Lot Development and Easement Agreement dated June 14, 2007 and recorded in the Register's Office on February 23, 2009 as CRFN: 2009000051737 (the “ZLDA"), a copy of which is attached hereto and made a part hereof as Exhibit C; WHEREAS, MYRTLE AVENUE I and University entered into a Declaration of Zoning Lot Restriction dated as of October 30, 2007 and recorded in the Register's Office on February 23,2009 as CRFN: 2009000051739 (the“Declaration”and attached hereto and made a part hereof as Exhibit D;

WHEREAS, on the date that the Declaration and ZLDA were entered into the Myrtle Ave II Property was a part of the Myrtle Ave I Property and the Subdivision occurred after the merger of the zoning lot and transfer of the development rights; WHEREAS, the parties desire to confirm that all rights acquired by Myrtle Avenue I under the Air Rights Agreements are also for the benefit of Myrtle AvenueIl. NOW, THEREFORE, for and in consideration of Ten ($10.00) Dollars and other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and legal sufficiency of which is hereby acknowledged, the parties hereby agree as follows: 1. Notwithstanding the recordationdatesof the ZLDA and Declaration, the Myrtle Avenue II Property is part of the merged zoning lot set forth in the ZLDA and Declaration. 2. Myrtle Avenue II is a third-party beneficiary of the Air Rights Agreements and shall have the benefit of all of the rights and privileges granted to Myrtle Avenue I under the Air Rights Agreements. 3. The right granted to Myrtle Avenue I, excluding the Excess Development Rights (as defined in the ZLDA) in the Air Rights Agreements, may be used for the development of the Myrtle Avenue II Property as Myrtle Avenue II deems 4. Notwithstanding anything contained in this Agreement to the contrary, Myrtle Avenue II shall be limited to 90,751 square feet of floor area. 5. This Agreement shall be governed by, and construed in accordance with, the laws of the State of New York. 6. This Agreement shall be binding upon and shall inure to the 7. This Agreement constitutes the full agreement between the parties with respect to the transaction contemplated herein, and all prior understandings and agreements are merged into this Agreement.
